李青山死了？

这对赵瞎子来说，倒还真是一件好事情。

首先。

王乃香没了李青山这个二流子忽悠，没了李青山作为依靠，赵贵一家子稍微用些手段，王乃香就得乖乖就范，用不了多久就得嫁给自己，自己也能早日尝到那小婆娘的味道。

除此之外。

接下来自己要去李青山门口骂娘的，李青山要是没死，难免会起冲突，虽然自己不惧怕李青山那个二流子。

但现在李青山死了。

这可是好事情，李三奎是个孬种，都被李老屯欺负成啥样子了也不敢说话，自己去骂娘，他们家估计都不敢开门。

“哈哈，那还真是大快人心呢！”赵瞎子也兴奋道。

“你这是去干嘛呢？”赵贵开口问道。

“去李青山家里骂娘！”

赵瞎子气哼哼道：“要不是李青山这个二流子，你家儿媳妇早就跟我睡在一起了，老子少享了多少天的福气，不得上门去骂一骂解解恨？”

“哈哈，去，快去吧……！”赵贵听到赵瞎子的话后，又笑了笑道：“我得先回去，把这个好消息告诉我家婆娘和儿子了。”

说罢。

二人匆忙分开，赵瞎子很快走到了李青山的院子前，清了清嗓子，脸上流露出一抹凶相。

“李青山，你个狗娘养的给我滚出来，你算个什么玩意，多管闲事的东西，我赵瞎子的事你都敢管，不想活了是不是？”

“老子好不容易个媳妇，你他娘的一肚子的坏水，非要给老子搅和了，你个绝户的东西！”

“不对，你家已经绝户了，哈哈……！”

赵瞎子在外面骂的起劲无比，声音洪亮，周围不少邻居都纷纷出来看戏，见到是赵瞎子在对着李青山家里骂，纷纷来了兴趣。

“赵瞎子，你在李青山家门口这么骂，不怕李青山回来跟你拼命啊？”

一名婶子开口问道。

“跟我拼命？”

“他从棺材里面蹦起来跟我拼命啊？”

“你们还不知道吧，李青山这小子死在老林子了，这就叫做恶有恶报，死的活该。”

“老子和王乃香都快要结婚了，这小子出来横插一杠子，当个搅屎棍，你说气人不气人？”

Li Qingshan is dead?

This is really a good thing for Blind Zhao.

first.

Without Li Qingshan, a second-rate fool, Wang Naixiang, and without Li Qingshan as a support, Wang Naixiang would have to obey if Zhao Gui's family used some tricks. It wouldn't take long for him to marry her, and he would be able to taste the taste of that little wife as soon as possible.

besides.

Next, he was going to scold Li Qingshan at his door. If Li Qingshan was not dead, there would inevitably be a conflict, although he was not afraid of that second-rate Li Qingshan.

But now Li Qingshan is dead.

This is a good thing. Li Sankui is a coward. He has been bullied by Li Laotun to the point where he doesn't dare to speak. If he scolds his mother by himself, their family probably won't dare to open the door.

"Haha, that's really satisfying!" Blind Zhao also said excitedly.

"What are you going to do?" Zhao Gui asked.

"Go to Li Qingshan's house and curse!"

Blind Zhao said angrily: "If it weren't for this second-rate Li Qingshan, your daughter-in-law would have slept with me long ago. How many days have I been blessed without having to come to your door to scold you to relieve my hatred?"

"Haha, go, go quickly...!" After hearing what Blind Zhao said, Zhao Gui smiled again and said, "I have to go back first and tell my mother-in-law and son the good news."

Say it.

The two separated in a hurry, and Zhao Xiazi quickly walked to Li Qingshan's yard, cleared his throat, and showed a fierce look on his face.

"Li Qingshan, you son of a bitch, get out of here. Who do you think you are? You're such a nosy person. You dare to meddle in my blind Zhao's affairs. You don't want to live anymore, do you?"

"I finally have a wife, but you are so full of bad intentions that you have to mess with me, you bastard!"

"No, your family is already extinct, haha...!"

Blind Zhao was scolding outside with great vigor and loud voice. Many neighbors came out to watch the show. When they saw that Blind Zhao was scolding Li Qingshan's house, they became interested.

"Blind Zhao, you scolded Li Qingshan in front of his house, aren't you afraid that Li Qingshan will come back and fight with you?"

An aunt asked.

"Fight with me?"

"He jumped out of the coffin and fought hard with me?"

"You don't know yet, but Li Qingshan died in the old forest. This is called evil being punished, and he deserves to die."

"I and Wang Naixiang are about to get married. This kid comes out to interfere and act as a troublemaker. Do you think it's irritating or not?"
